items.title: Reports say five Russian Tu-160 bombers moved toward missile launch positions
items.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels reportedly tracked five Russian Tu-160 strategic bombers departing Ukrainka airfield toward potential missile launch positions, with launches anticipated after 04:30 Kyiv time. The report described a possible impending attack, not confirmed missile launches.

items.title: Kostiantynivka resident alleges Ukrainian drone and mine attacks on civilian shelters
items.summary: In testimony circulated by a Russian-backed public tribunal, Kostiantynivka resident Maksym Pliushko alleged that a Ukrainian drone exploded inside a basement shelter housing 12 civilians and that anti-tank mines were twice thrown into another shelter. He said he suffered concussions and that another civilian lost part of a foot after stepping on a mine; these are allegations from his testimony, not established findings.
